title: Sleeping Princess
content: Here's the Belgian filly Princess, a sketch I did nearly six months ago, July or so.She's a big horse now, about the size of a standard riding horse. The farmer, Lenny, says she may end up bigger than her mom.Here are thosesketches from last springwhen she was just two weeks old. The technique is water-soluble colored pencils and water-brushes, one of which was filled with dilute brown fountain pen ink.
